quests.instruction: IDENTIFY THE CONNECTED SPEECH PHENOMENON IN THE PHRASE
quests.hint: Two consonants meet right where 'weekend' meets 'trip'. Pay attention to the /d/ — in fast natural speech, is it dropped rather than pronounced?
quests.explanation: Rather than forcing three or four consonants together, speakers quietly drop the /d/ at the end of "weekend". The result, "weekend trip", keeps its meaning but loses that one sound.
